chunks: Yet they say: 'If Ar-Rahman had so pleased we would not have worshipped them.' They have no knowledge of it in the least. They only make up lies.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنُ: Ar-Rahman (The Merciful), a name of God

ai.seo_question: What did the polytheists claim about their idol worship, and how does the Quran refute it?
ai.summary: In Surah Az-Zukhruf, the Quran critiques the Meccan polytheists' claim that their idol worship was divinely mandated, exposing their assertion as baseless speculation ('yakhruṣūn') rather than informed conviction. Shia exegesis highlights this as a rejection of blind traditionalism (taqlīd), emphasizing that true worship requires conscious knowledge and deliberate choice rather than mere imitation of ancestors.
